heading: Wednesday Night
text: Clear skies with valley fog and scattered frost.
temperature: 30s to lower 40s, mid to upper 20s in the cold spots

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly sunny after any early fog.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly to partly sunny. Chance of late-day showers far south.

heading: Saturday
text: Rising chance of showers south and east, chance north and west.
